### Critical Gaps

#### 1. **HandleHash** — hash.go
**Missing:**
- `"all"` algorithm returns all 4 hashes
- Invalid algorithm error
- Empty input handling

```go
// Test skeleton
func TestHandleHash_All(t *testing.T) {
    body := bytes.NewBufferString(`{"input":"hello","alg":"all"}`)
    req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/api/hash", body)
    w := httptest.NewRecorder()
    HandleHash(w, req)
    if w.Code != http.StatusOK { t.Errorf("expected 200, got %d", w.Code) }
    var resp map[string]string
    json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &resp)
    output := resp["output"]
    if !strings.Contains(output, "MD5:") || !strings.Contains(output, "SHA512:") {
        t.Error("expected all hash algorithms in output")
    }
}

func TestHandleHash_InvalidAlg(t *testing.T) {
    body := bytes.NewBufferString(`{"input":"test","alg":"invalid"}`)
    req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/api/hash", body)
    w := httptest.NewRecorder()
    HandleHash(w, req)
    if w.Code != http.StatusBadRequest { t.Errorf("expected 400, got %d", w.Code) }
}
```
